scope.market_definition: The global cyber-physical systems (CPS) security market encompasses channel partners that distribute, resell, integrate, manage, and consult on security solutions for industrial control systems, SCADA, IoT, and other cyber-physical environments. This market includes system integrators, managed security service providers (MSSPs), value-added resellers (VARs), distributors, consulting partners, and resellers operating worldwide.
